description: The file defines utility functions for handling chat session filters, including generating human-friendly session names and resolving a list of recent chat sessions based on activity timestamps and session keys.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: A data class representing a chat session, including its key and last update timestamp.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Generates a human-friendly label from a raw session key by stripping prefixes, cleaning up separators, and applying title casing.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Resolves a list of chat session entries to show recent and main sessions, filtering based on last activity time and handling special session key logic.
